data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 recorded a small gross adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 0.2m (c.1.97% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 10.154m), driven by modest upward re-estimates on older underwriting years offset by favourable run-off elsewhere. The calendar year technical account records a net surplus of GBP 0.8m relating to reassessment of prior accident years (net of reinsurance), while the underwriting commentary also notes prior releases (eg a GBP 0.3m release for the 2014 underwriting year). Overall the movement is minor and reflects routine re-assessment/IBNR recalibration rather than a single large event.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserve taken from the claims outstanding reconciliation (note) where figures are presented in GBP '000s. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' GROSS figure was printed; a small gross prior-year development was computed from the published gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative paid + outstanding per UW year) - this calculation was used as the primary source for prior_year_development_gbp_m. The narrative sentence available in the technical account refers to net (after reinsurance) movement; the reported numeric prior-year figure here is GROSS as derived from the triangle. Confidence in the computed PYD is moderate (0.8).
